    Profile

    A talented warrior proficient in both literary and combative arts, Kuza was born into the Kaiko Clan, a prominent warrior family of Wadatsumi. Although generally courteous and aloof in manner, when taunted his silver tongue quickly becomes a harsh and poisonous one. Chivalrous of heart and charitably overbearing, he finds it difficult to open up to those around him.

    Origin: Wadatsumi
    Gender: Male
    Height: 183cm
    Weight: 73kg
    Birthday: Dec 24
    Blood Type: Type Kn
    Zodiac: Moon of the Nightmare Cherry Blossom
    Likes: Meditation in his loft
    Hobbies: Collecting art from Wadatsumi
    Illust: RINZO
    CV: 興津和幸
